entries.title: Job 40:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah answered Job and said,

entries.title: Job 40:2
segments: Shall he that will contend with the Almighty instruct [him]? he that reproveth +God, let him answer it.

entries.title: Job 40:3
segments: And Job answered Jehovah and said,

entries.title: Job 40:4
segments: Behold, I am nought: what shall I answer thee? I will lay my hand upon my mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:5
segments: Once have I spoken, and I will not answer; yea twice, but I will proceed no further.

entries.title: Job 40:6
segments: ¶And Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind and said,

entries.title: Job 40:7
segments: Gird up now thy loins like a man: I will demand of thee, and inform thou me.

entries.title: Job 40:8
segments: Wilt thou also annul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me that thou mayest be righteous?

entries.title: Job 40:9
segments: Hast thou an arm like *God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

entries.title: Job 40:10
segments: Deck thyself now with glory and excellency, and clothe thyself with majesty and splendour.

entries.title: Job 40:11
segments: Cast abroad the ragings of thine anger, and look on every one that is proud, and abase him:

entries.title: Job 40:12
segments: Look on every one that is proud, bring him low, and tread down the wicked in their place:

entries.title: Job 40:13
segments: Hide them in the dust together; bind their faces in secret.

entries.title: Job 40:14
segments: Then will I also praise thee, because thy right hand saveth thee.

entries.title: Job 40:15
segments: ¶See now the behemoth, which I made with thee: he eateth grass as an ox.

entries.title: Job 40:16
segments: Behold now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the muscles of his belly.

entries.title: Job 40:17
segments: He bendeth his tail like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are woven together.

entries.title: Job 40:18
segments: His bones are tubes of bronze, his members are like bars of iron.

entries.title: Job 40:19
segments: He is the chief of *God's ways: he that made him gave him his sword.

entries.title: Job 40:20
segments: For the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

entries.title: Job 40:21
segments: He lieth under lotus-bushes, in the covert of the reed and fen:

entries.title: Job 40:22
segments: Lotus-bushes cover him with their shade; the willows of the brook surround him.

entries.title: Job 40:23
segments: Lo, the river overfloweth--he startleth not: he is confident though a Jordan break forth against his mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:24
segments: Shall he be taken in front? will they pierce through [his] nose in the trap?
